usage_note: OECD citation required; retain source attribution. Monthly observations are period labels, not publication timestamps. No daily benchmark identity is implied.
definition: OECD Financial Market: Share Prices, normalized monthly index (2015=100). This is the OECD country share-price series, not a daily named FTSE/DAX/CAC/TSX/ASX/KOSPI/Nifty/CSI benchmark or total-return index.
